paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism
caption: : The distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, over the WildChat conversations that are matched to online articles from the two identified news agencies.
model_annotation: This donut chart, titled “Stimulus Type,” visually represents the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs, as captured in WildChat conversations matched to online articles from two identified news agencies. The chart is divided into eight distinct colored segments, each labeled with its category and corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 26.4%, shown in a dark red. Following this are “Press Release” at 18.7% (yellow), “External News Article” at 18.1% (dark green), “Interview” at 8.8% (dark purple), “Organizational Report” at 7.7% (light purple), “Event Posting” at 6.6% (dark brown), “Intra-agency news article” at 4.9% (blue), and “Organizational Website” at 4.9% (dark blue). “Social Media Post” is the smallest segment at 1.1% (light orange). Each category is clearly labeled with its percentage outside the ring, and the chart includes a central white space with the title. The segments appear to be arranged in a roughly descending order by size, clockwise from the top.
